verdict.rationale: a-Shell works on ordinary files on the device. The docs say you can create, compress and move files, then send them to other apps through iOS file sharing (docs-5, docs-6). You can also open other apps' folders with pickFolder (gh-5) and script file handling via Apple Shortcuts (gh-4), so user data stays in standard formats and can be taken elsewhere. However, the docs never describe a dedicated export-everything or leave-the-app flow, so portability is inferred from general file-handling features. Missing for 10: an explicit documented 'export all data' feature, any mention of exporting app state (command history, config, bookmarks) in open formats, and independent hands-on confirmation of a full data takeout.
